summary: A survival base-building gate module that fills one 3.0 m wall slot, 3.0 m tall: two heavy log gate posts and… joints leaf_l, leaf_r; options tier; sockets socket_join_left, socket_join_right.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.base_gate_wood or place "prefab": "base_gate_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
